about: Sizes in MB for the first-run screen, per system (windows, macos, linux) or 'all'. mb is the download, disk_mb what it takes on disk once installed. 'measured' names the CI run that measured an entry; values without it are estimates (the screen says 'about' for every number). Refresh with daemon/tests/platform_real/first_run_sizes.py from the first-run job's log. Core: download from pip's cache, disk with this computer's own Python (the 'auto' jobs). private_python: the extra disk when Heliox brings its own Python and uv (private minus auto job); its download is still an estimate, since uv and Python do not go through pip's cache.
